title: Rhythm Sprint 2 — Recognition RCA

taxonomy.label: Saturated beamStrength misread as sixteenth (and beams dropped when strength>22)
examples: dense m2–4: truth 8 eighths; gen mix of 16th/eighth; noteDur often sixteenth with beams=0 while raw strength=29
tuplets m7: truth eighths; gen 16th/eighth; strength=29 rejected by countBeams
taxonomy.mechanism: measureBeamStrength saturates at BEAM_SCAN_X (~29) for continuous beams. inferNoteDuration maps beamStrength≥14→sixteenth before the eighth branch. countBeams returns 0 when strength>22, so beams=0 and beamStrength is not persisted — gap quantization then emits 16ths/quarters without beam caps.

taxonomy.label: extendPenultimateHalfBeforeFinalQuarter promotes quarters→halves
examples: grand m1–3: treble onsets @0,@4,@8,@12 with noteDur=quarter, but event @8 becomes half when bass+treble share beat before lone final quarter
taxonomy.mechanism: Heuristic extends shared penultimate-beat quarters to half. Fires on simple 4-quarter+2-half grand texture; no onset errors (pure duration).

taxonomy.label: Gap duration stretch to quarter when beam evidence missing (Eighth→quarter)
examples: dense m2/m4: events with noteDur=quarter, beams=0, gap-assigned quarter/eighth
taxonomy.mechanism: Downstream of saturated-beam bug: without beams/beamStrength on notes, refineEventDurationsFromBeamEvidence and hasBeamEvidenceForNotes cannot cap gap stretches.

taxonomy.label: TAB positional slots invent 0.75q / spurious leading 16th
examples: tab m2/m3/m6: truth 4 quarters; gen @1:16th + three dotted-eighths + stretched quarter (starts 1,2,5,8,11)
taxonomy.mechanism: detectTabNotation buildTabTimingBuckets / assignMonotonicSlots — separate tab-vector path; no stems/flags. Extra onset + uneven slots → d=3 (0.75q).
taxonomy.trap: Do not fix via processVectorOmrPage; tab path is detectTabNotation.js

taxonomy.label: Duration defects co-located with onset defects (dense/tab/tuplets)
taxonomy.mechanism: Gap-primary duration makes onset errors look like duration errors.

taxonomy.label: No tuplet time-modification recognition
examples: m3: truth 3:2 eighth triplets; gen 16ths with no time-modification
taxonomy.note: Separate from beam bug; lower volume.

recommendedFix.title: Stop treating saturated beamStrength as sixteenth; accept long beams as eighths

changes: Remove or demote `beamStrength >= 14 → sixteenth` in inferNoteDuration (require real secondary-beam evidence for 16ths).
In countBeams: treat strength >= 8 as beamed even when strength > 22 (long continuous beams). Keep hollow/half guarded by hollow branch order.
Persist beamStrength on the object returned by enrichNoteheadRhythm so hasBeamEvidenceForNotes / inferredBeamDurationCap work.
No logic change required once beamStrength/beams are correct; gap caps will start firing.

expectedImpact.piano-dense-advanced-vector: Primary: Eighth→16th ×30; secondary: Eighth→quarter ×27 via beam caps; onset 0.25/0.5 may improve
expectedImpact.piano-rhythm-tuplets-vector: Eighth→16th ×8; partial onset improvement; tuplet×10 NOT fixed
expectedImpact.piano-grand-voices-vector: Little/no change (hollow branch protects halves; Quarter→half is separate heuristic)

recommendedFix.whySmallest: Three tightly related edits in one file (detectNoteRhythmFeatures.js), no evaluator/balancing changes. Directly addresses the highest-volume duration message (Eighth→16th) and unblocks existing beam-cap machinery for Eighth→quarter.

secondaryFix.title: Guard extendPenultimateHalfBeforeFinalQuarter with confident quarter stem evidence

traps: Vector event duration is gap-primary (buildNoteEventsFromGroups); notehead durationType is often ignored except as evidence for caps/heuristics.
Measure balancing / clampMeasureEventDurations can hide underfull measures; dense flagged playback measures [2,6,12,13,16].
beamStrength was never persisted — diagnostics and hasBeamEvidenceForNotes silently see 0.
countBeams upper bound >22 was likely meant to reject staff-line saturation; hollow-first in inferNoteDuration protects grand halves if long beams are accepted.
guitar-tab-sparse uses source=tab-vector (detectTabNotation.js), not processVectorOmrPage durationMeta.
All dense/tab/tuplet duration defects are onset-coupled; grand is the only pure-duration fixture.
Pitch/clef errors on dense are severe — rhythm pairing can attribute wrong durations to wrong notes; still, beam misclassification is independently visible on noteheads.
Do not modify frozen semantic evaluator.
